paras: The Alpha-N Carbon Aeroblades are designed to fit the BMW M2 G87 2023+, and are available in Australia through iilumolab. Developed and manufactured in Germany by Alpha-N Performance, a brand with deep roots in BMW motorsport, these carbon fibre aeroblades extend the aggressive design language of the G87 front fascia while improving airflow management around the front bumper.

Positioned along the outer edges of the front bumper, the aeroblades guide airflow around the vehicle's front corners, reducing turbulence and improving aerodynamic efficiency. The result is a subtle aerodynamic gain paired with a more purposeful motorsport appearance that complements the sharp body lines of the G87 M2.
